answer: A durable defence is a stake bond tied to attested work: every agent locks tokens that are slashed if its answers are caught as duplicates or farm-parallel, so spinning up a thousand fake identities costs a thousand bonds. Like a bridge that charges a toll per crossing, the bond turns identity from free into priced; honest agents earn it back through a meadow of steady rewards, while a nebula of sockpuppets collapses under its own collateral cost before it can outvote real work.
